purpose: Add metre-scaled authored soil and rocky-ground PBR detail to the Atlas terrain material while preserving its existing biome colours and continuous local frame.

artDirection.summary: Natural compacted soil and fractured rocky ground, used as close-range triplanar surface detail beneath the existing planet-specific palette.

deliverables.format: Poly Haven 1K source maps and CC0 provenance
512px RGBA albedo-roughness and tangent-space normal PNG maps

visual: soil and rock texture detail is readable on grounded views without replacing the existing planet palette
soil and rock transitions follow the existing biome weights without visible tile seams
technical: source files match official Poly Haven file hashes and retain asset-level CC0 metadata
runtime maps use normal OpenGL tangent convention and match the 512 pixel memory budget
all shader coordinates remain continuous across adjacent tiles and local-frame rebases
runtime: browser comparison reaches a grounded dry-soil view and a wet riverbank view with no shader or WebGL errors

license.attribution: Poly Haven textures by Charlotte Baglioni (Dirt) and Rob Tuytel (Rock Ground); author records are preserved in bundle metadata

provenance.notes: Runtime maps are downsampled and channel-packed from the two source PBR texture sets. Input file hashes and API metadata are preserved in bundle.json and ground-pbr-v1.asset.json. No generated geometry or model checkpoint is used.
